newsitem.title: FINLAND: VAAHTO SEES IMPROVING PROFIT TREND.
newsitem.headline: VAAHTO SEES IMPROVING PROFIT TREND.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Vaahto Oy said on Tuesday its outlook was good and it expected sales growth and the profit trend in the second half of the financial year to end-February to be stronger than the fist half.
"Despite a weaker-than-expected economic sutiation, the group's profit trend is expected to improve further in the second half of the financial year," it said in its March-August interim report.
"Sales growth in the second half can be assumed clearly to exceed growth (in March-August)," it said.
Its March-August net sales rose 43 percent to 101.8 million markka and its profit before extraordinary items rose to 12.2 million markka from 5.9 million in the correspding period in 1995.
In the previous financial year to end-February 1996, Vaahto's net sales were 162.5 million markka and its profit before extraordinary items was 14.7 million.
